findings.issue: Tarcore is frozen as لُبّ القار (plural ألباب القار, which Franz's Tarcore dialogue uses). نوى القار is a third, unapproved rendering of the same collectible.

The '-stone' element is dropped entirely. Every sibling in this list is حجر X (حجر المُريد، حجر العملاق، حجر الوابل…), so this row alone stops reading as a Tarstone. جَلَبة on its own is also read first as 'clamour/din', not 'scab'.
'-stone' is dropped, same as Captive's Scabstone, breaking the حجر X naming family the whole Tarstone list follows.

'The Conqueror' is a named boss; the boss-defeated line Dialogue_Dlg_ConquerorBossDefeated renders him الغازي. Two different Arabic names for the same character across the build — one of them must give.
'Core' is النواة here but لُبّ in Tarcore (لُبّ القار, frozen). Endless=السَّرْمَدي is correct; only the noun is off-family.

findings.source_en: Ash gently wafts from this smoldering relic.
findings.ar: يتصاعد الرماد رفيقًا من هذا الأثر المُتَّقِد.
findings.issue: المُتَّقِد means ablaze/blazing; 'smouldering' is the opposite image — burning low without flame, which is why only ash rises from it.
findings.suggested_ar: يتصاعد الرماد رفيقًا من هذا الأثر الجامر.
